After 27 years unbeaten, Taisuke Kodama's course record was improved by Tadese Tola in 2013 as the Ethiopian beat the previous mark by nineteen seconds with 2:07:16 hours.[24] In 2019 Mathew Kisorio improved the course record with a time of 2:07:06.
